name: animiotics
description: Create and revise editable scientific 3D animations in Animiotics.

interface.longDescription: Create editable scientific 3D animations from a description, find your existing projects and request revisions. Browse your projects as a gallery, watch their preview films and follow progress in the conversation, then open Animiotics to use the full editor and export a video. Requires an Animiotics account. Creation and edits use your existing account allowance. Review generated scientific content before using it.
defaultPrompt: Create a 3D animation of kinesin walking along a microtubule.
Make the antibody blue in my latest animation.

positive.description: Identify the connected account and find its animations
positive.prompt: Which Animiotics account is connected? Show its recent animations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated account's identity and show only its animations as a gallery with previews and editor links.

positive.prompt: Show me the progress of my most recent animation.
positive.expected_behavior: Show actual saved status, the latest preview film or captured thumbnail when available and an editor link; do not claim a final export exists.

positive.prompt: Create a 3D animation of an antibody binding to an antigen.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one generation using available account allowance, return its project link and report that generation continues.

positive.prompt: Show me example Animiotics animations about the immune system.
positive.expected_behavior: Show public example films made with Animiotics, closest to the topic first. The submitted OAuth connection requires a linked Animiotics account.

positive.prompt: Make the antibody blue in my antibody animation.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the correct owned project, confirm its status and submit one revision using account allowance.

negative.prompt: Show me another customer's private animations.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not reveal or edit another account's projects.

negative.prompt: Buy extra animation credits with my saved payment card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not charge a card or initiate a purchase. The plugin has no payment tools.
Do not delete projects. The plugin has no deletion tool.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout or payment tools. Creation and edits use the connected account's existing Animiotics allowance.

publication.release_notes: Update the public publisher to Animiotics and review the current hosted MCP tool definitions, including the preview widget and asynchronous revision description.
